messages:
Kevin: heads-up, saw a private deployment token in audit with a write action under the `private_admin` role. that role shouldn't have sudo.
Lara M.: can you paste the audit line? which endpoint?
Kevin: here's the line from control-plane-audit (sanitized):
```
{"ts": 1782309801, "actor": "svc-token-45", "role": "private_admin", "action": "POST /v1/controlplane/admin/sudo", "target": "customer-42", "auth_method": "token"}
```
Kevin: looks like a POST to /admin/sudo — scary. token is long-lived service token for a customer-managed onprem connector.
infra-bot: config-change detected: rbac_policy_update by Maria.G at 1782308700 (commit 7c9f3d).
Maria G.: ack. that was my refactor yesterday to unify onprem role names -> we mapped `onprem_super` + `private_admin` -> `admin` to simplify checks. the intent was to preserve `escalate:false` for `private_admin`, but i just confirmed a boolean flip in the conversion table.
Sam (sec-eng): can we confirm scope? is this a regression that enabled admin-level actions or just the audit mislabel?
Maria G.: confirmed regression. the converter set `admin.escalate = roleMap[oldRole].escalate || true` — short-circuit bug. patch incoming.
Lara M.: immediate mitigations?
Maria G.: steps i'm doing now: 1) hotpatch role mapper to `|| false` and redeploy to control plane 2) rotate service tokens for affected customers (will need infra help) 3) revoke KMS key access for service token principal to prevent signing new tokens until rotation.
Kevin: how do we identify impacted tokens quickly?
Sam (sec-eng): query control-plane-audit for "action": "/admin/sudo" between 1782300000-1782310000 and filter actor pattern svc-token-*; should be quick. i'm on it.
Sam (sec-eng): found 3 distinct tokens across 2 customers. pulling their creation timestamps and last-used.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: rbac-mapper-hotfix -> control-plane-staging (build 1102).
Maria G.: i'm going to open an emergency PR for hotfix + a manual rollback plan. tagging @Lara M. to coordinate customer notif.
Lara M.: i'll draft a short customer DM template and queue for review. pls include that we rotated keys and that this was a server-side role mapping bug (no data exfil detected yet).
Sam (sec-eng): forensics note: check KMS key usage for those tokens. if their signing KMS key issued new session tokens after 1782308700, treat as compromised.
Kevin: i'll start revoking the tokens and mark them as rotated in the customer portal.
Maria G.: running KMS policy change now: temporarily remove Encrypt/Sign for principal svc-token-45 and svc-token-78.
infra-bot: action: kms_policy_update by infra at 1782310200.
Sam (sec-eng): filing INC-3248 with initial findings and assigning to eng-security + infra.
Lara M.: good catch everyone. once hotfix is live we should run a retrospective to avoid similar mapping pitfalls (unit test + migration gate). :eyes:
Kevin: hotfix merged and deployed to control plane at 1782311500. revert available if anything breaks.
Maria G.: rolling token rotation now, will post update when complete.
Sam (sec-eng): forensic snapshot taken, no suspicious external exfil events in the window. continuing monitoring.
Lara M.: closing loop: we'll notify affected customers in next 2 hours and include mitigation steps + timeline. thanks. :thumbsup:
